req.title: Return 404 on unknown post
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when GET/POST /<id>/update or /<id>/delete references a non-existent post id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a 404 status code when attempting to update or delete a non-existent post. This behavior ensures that the client is informed of invalid operations on resources that do not exist. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage of this requirement.

tests.name: test_update_non_existent_post
preconditions: Post ID 999 does not exist in the database
actions: Attempt to update post with ID 999
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as a valid user
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Attempt to update a non-existent post
r = client.post('/999/update', data={'title': 'New Title', 'body': 'New Body'})
assert r.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_update_existing_post
preconditions: Post ID 1 exists in the database
actions: Attempt to update post with ID 1
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as a valid user
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Ensure post with ID 1 exists
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Existing Title', 'body': 'Existing Body'})

# Attempt to update an existing post
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated Body'})
assert r.status_code == 200
